lines: Ever wondered why there's always water sitting in your toilet?
It's held there by this hidden bend.
That little puddle was a seal.
And right under it? The sewer.
No bend, no water. No water, no seal!
So the sewer gas comes straight up... into your bathroom!
That rotten egg smell? That's hydrogen sulfide.
And in high doses, it's toxic!
The fix? In [1775|seventeen seventy-five], a watchmaker named Alexander Cumming patented a toilet with an S-shaped bend.
One tiny curve! And homes stopped smelling like the sewer.
Pro tip: if a bathroom you rarely use starts to stink, just run the water.
So... what should I delete next?
